blurb: Guests can camp in tents, RV sites, vintage campers, or tiny cabins near Summersville Lake. Activities include hiking to the Summersville Lighthouse, boating, fishing, biking, and enjoying campfires. Facilities include clean restrooms, showers, Wi-Fi, BBQ areas, and a large dog park.
